description: Angular component for resource dialog in Thingsboard UI, handling resource creation/editing with form validation and resource upload via ResourceService.

classes.name: ResourcesDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for managing resources, including form validation, resource upload, and dialog control.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets the form as dirty after view initialization if adding a new resource.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state, considering custom validation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without returning data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form and uploads resource(s), then closes dialog with result.
